meta.objective: Let Academy run the same named agent through Claude Code or Codex, preserving shared agent identity, prompt surfaces, skills, memory, project-local merge, and nightly runtime behavior.
scope: Keep Claude Code as the default runtime.
Use the same Academy surfaces and memory identity for both runtimes.
Preserve user global Codex config/auth/MCPs/skills/plugins while adding Academy Codex profile behavior.
Expose Academy universal skills to Codex through `.agents/skills` as a hard v1 requirement.
Make scheduled/nightly runs use Claude, Codex, or last-used runtime according to the agent/user mode.
out_of_bounds: Do not make Codex the default runtime.
Do not remove Claude Code support or its project plugin path.
Do not translate provider passthrough flags between Claude and Codex.
Do not build a Codex plugin marketplace publishing flow.
Do not build a separate `academy hire --agent codex` flow.
Do not implement cross-workspace blended RAG memory.
Do not add new npm dependencies unless implementation proves it necessary.
Do not set or override user Codex auth/provider/MCP/global-plugin configuration in Academy-generated profiles.
Do not rework Subspace memory architecture beyond Codex launch parity with the existing Academy memory identity.

requirements_trace.requirement: `academy run <agent>` remains Claude Code by default.
`academy run <agent> --agent claude-code|codex -- ...` selects runtime and preserves passthrough.
Both runtimes use the same rendered Academy surfaces and protected agent identity.
Codex uses the user's global config/auth/MCPs/skills/plugins while adding an Academy profile layer.
Academy universal skills are available to Codex in v1.
Scheduled/nightly Academy runs use Claude-only, Codex-only, or mixed last-used runtime behavior.
Existing Claude behavior and memory sync remain covered.
README documents runtime selector, defaults, Codex layering, and skill/config behavior.
